title: Design tokens
intro: The Diffuse (v3) design system — per-behavior generative fields, warm paper + ink, the Hanken/Space-Mono data voice, stickers, logo and the branded emails. Mirrored from grandma-app/constants/theme.ts (the diffuse* exports). Click any swatch, field or export to copy.

fields.intro: The only thing that changes per behavior under Diffuse: a 4-stop generative gradient field (g1→g4) plus one accent for CTA/ink moments. Type + icons stay identical across behaviors.

type.rolesIntro: Assign by meaning, never by size — the one clear Diffuse rule.

shape.grainNote: Laid over gradient fields for the soft grainy look.

emails.intro: Branded Supabase auth emails, Diffuse-styled. Paste from grandma-app/supabase/email-templates/ into Supabase → Auth → Email Templates.

stickers.intro: The current Character-blob icon system (active under Diffuse) — {count} concepts rendered live from grandma-app/components/characters/Characters.tsx, grouped by behavior. Each is a 48×48 blob with a per-concept hue. Gaps per behavior are noted below each group.

pre_pregnancy.label: Pre-Pregnancy / Cycle
pre_pregnancy.gaps: Missing dedicated blobs: cycle phases (follicular/luteal), hormones (E/P/LH), cervical fluid, a real BBT/thermometer (temperature reuses a droplet), fertile-window.

pregnancy.label: Pregnancy
pregnancy.gaps: Missing: trimester / gestational-week, baby-size-by-week, birth plan & birth-type, labor phases (early/active/transition/golden-hour/postpartum), kegel / nesting / hospital-bag.

kids.label: Kids
kids.gaps: Missing: teeth / tooth, diaper sub-types (pee/poop/mixed), nursery gear (crib/rattle/stroller/pacifier/teddy), specific food types (fruit/veg).

general.label: General
general.gaps: One bell covers 13 notification types; no per-mode blobs; no scan-type blobs; medicine ≈ health hue/shape; no dedicated vitamin/supplement blob.
